Package org.Jtech.Service

Class AuthService

java.lang.Object
org.Jtech.Service.AuthService
@Service public class AuthService extends Object
Auth Service Purpose: Provides authentication-related business logic including user credential validation and password management. Scope: - Authenticate users using email credentials - Retrieve user identity information - Handle password change operations Metadata: Created on : 2025-12-29 Author : Mohit Singh Notes: This service contains only authentication business logic. HTTP concerns are handled in the AuthController layer.
